key_insight: Ferroic z² quadrupolar order in Ba₂MgReO₆ arises from a vibronically driven linear–quartic coupling generated by virtual excitations to the J_eff = 1/2 doublet.
engineering_relevance: The study clarifies coupled electronic and lattice behavior in a double-perovskite quantum material, rather than demonstrating AI or solar-cell applications.
method: Calculate superexchange, quadrupole–quadrupole, vibronic, and virtual-excitation interactions from first principles.
Separate interaction contributions to identify the mechanism driving quadrupolar order.
evidence_signal: The calculated ground state quantitatively reproduces experimentally observed quadrupolar order parameters and associated structural distortions, according to the abstract.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical error metrics or evidence of transferability to other perovskites or photovoltaic devices.
paper_title: Origin of quadrupolar order in the 5d$^1$ double perovskite Ba$_2$MgReO$_6$
